title: Bukele Says Haitian Gangs Are Holding Four Salvadoran GSF Members Hostage
detail: On October 21, 2026 Salvadoran President Nayib Bukele said Haitian gangs were holding the four aviation technicians missing since the October 18 ambush and announced a military rescue operation. He did not name the group responsible; the Gang Suppression Force did not immediately comment.
